Nintendogs + Cats: Toy Poodle & New Friends

nintendogs + cats, a game that lets players interact with realistic puppies - and kittens - in a variety of fun ways. There are three versions of the software, each with different starting breeds: French bulldog, toy poodle and golden retriever. But in each version players can unlock and enjoy more than 20 different breeds.

nintendogs + cats, un juego que te permite interactuar con cachorros realistas (y gatitos) de variadas y divertidas formas. Hay tres versiones del software, cada una con razas iniciales distintas: bulldog francés, caniche toy y golden retriever. Pero en cada versión los jugadores pueden desbloquear y disfrutar más de 20 razas diferentes.

Nintendogs puppies are back in the palm of your hand on the Nintendo 3DS system, with even cuter and more expressive puppies and, for the first time, kittens!
